items.text: It’s important that we do what we can to ensure our children have quality health care services, particularly when it comes to mental health. MORE on funding I helped announce recently that supports this goal: https://t.co/8xjWFaOOpS

Research continues to show that exercise can slow the progression of Parkinson’s disease. I had the chance to catch a boxing class at @YMCACharleston for those living with the disease & can tell you firsthand that these folks are literally taking Parkinson’s one punch at a time! https://t.co/uuyV10p7kL

Patients should have transparency into the real cost of the drugs they pay for. It shouldn’t be complicated.

That’s why I’m a co-sponsor of the Pharmacy Benefit Manager Transparency Act, which bans deceptive pricing tactics.

Throughout my time in the Senate, connecting West Virginia with reliable broadband coverage has been a top priority.
 
Today, I joined state and local officials in Spencer to celebrate the dedication of a multi-county fiber network project, made possible by collaboration between Citynet and local entities in Roane County.
 
Partnerships like this with Citynet, show the impact we can make when it comes to better-serving communities and advancing our goal of connecting more homes and businesses here in West Virginia to high-speed internet access.

Far too many in WV experience the devastating consequences of addiction. The SUPPORT Act could provide needed relief by focusing on prevention, treatment and recovery, and addresses new challenges like increases of fentanyl overdoses and other threats.

@GOPHELP’s passage of this legislation recently is an important step in making sure we continue these important programs.
